About Carmela Berger

Carmela brings handmade silk thread shawls and dresses from Argentina to the US. Each piece is crocheted, knotted or fringed by hand in small numbers, so styles and colors come and go.

Questions about fit, colors or a special order? Write to Carmela directly and she’ll get back to you within a day.
